commit.message:
Update the Guardian extra-policy snapshot for retained instructions (#47287)

## What changed

Update `extra_policy_reaches_guardian_review` to expect a retained user
instructions section before the transcript, including the source-order notice
and the original user request. Adjust the subsequent snapshot item numbers.

GitOrigin-RevId: 9e57f9bb7cdc9318787d083bf4350143a1353287

Add regression coverage for message board unsubscribe persistence (#47281)

Verify that unsubscribing from a message board thread remains effective
after posting to that thread and resuming the session. The runtime test
checks that replies from a child agent produce no `CHANNEL_POST` notices
while unsubscribed and that explicit resubscription restores delivery.

Use gated streaming responses to keep the recipient active during each
reply and drain worker completion messages before checking notices.

GitOrigin-RevId: fe2695a46722a94e6fca86a3d3bd49c0b8bb7ee7

Enable Guardian thread context by default (#47275)

## What changed

Mark `guardianv2.thread_context` as stable and enable it by default for synchronous and asynchronous Guardian reviews. Keep it independent of the Guardian v2 `enabled` toggle and preserve explicit configuration and profile overrides. Update the configuration schema documentation to match.

## Testing

Update coverage for default configuration and sender user messages, review prompt snapshots, history retention across compaction, and checkpoint provenance. Assert that later user input invalidates an in-flight review's authorization. Keep legacy transcript budgeting coverage by explicitly disabling thread context in that test.

GitOrigin-RevId: 19afd34d7bfc0ee36bbf878089c68b732a21bc6a

Allow Guardian sync review across compaction hash differences (#47272)

## Why

Thread-owned Guardian review rejected usable parent compaction checkpoints when the reviewer's `comp_hash` differed or was unknown, even though the synchronous reviewer can consume those checkpoints.

## What changed

Remove the synchronous reviewer's compaction hash compatibility check and the associated hash plumbing. Pass usable checkpoints to the backend for payload validation, while continuing to fail closed on unusable checkpoints and review errors.

## Testing

Update compaction and resume tests to expect retained evidence with different, missing, or empty reviewer hashes, while preserving rejection of empty checkpoint content.

GitOrigin-RevId: bbc4f5a2e697f832f815dcf8bda4d4a652f06b8a

Implement `AgentControl` for `LocalAgentControl` (#47271)

## What changed

Add an adapter that delegates the shared controller interface to existing local agent operations, including lifecycle management, message delivery, status observation, budget accounting, and shared settings.

Align the trait signatures and documentation with local behavior: separate advisory capacity checks from execution tracking, preserve best-effort completion reporting, and return optional guardian evidence. Use `SessionId` for controller identity and replace paginated queries with loaded-agent listing by path prefix, removing the obsolete types and exports.

GitOrigin-RevId: 15bb7135e0f180d207390f6f2e75f63b9058816a

Stream agent snapshots from local status subscriptions (#47267)

## What changed

- Return `StatusSubscription` streams of `AgentInfo` snapshots from local status subscriptions, including agent metadata and configuration.
- Emit the initial snapshot before subsequent coalesced updates. Use a weak thread reference and retain the last observed configuration so published final updates remain available after the runtime is dropped.
- Update completion notifications and `wait_agent` to consume snapshot streams, propagate subscription errors from `wait_agent`, and fall back to the latest status when a stream ends.

## Testing

Update the shutdown subscription test to verify that shutdown before the first poll preserves the initial `PendingInit` snapshot followed by `Shutdown`.

GitOrigin-RevId: beb46952cbcc9bddf65a4d6603fea939d5ace8b9

Expose hosted plugin extensions in app-server summaries (#47263)

## What changed

- Request installed-plugin metadata with `includeExtensions=true` and carry optional `extensions` through the cache into `PluginSummary`.
- Add typed declarations for global, settings, thread, and file entrypoints, quick actions, settings tools, icons, and search mention providers. Update JSON schemas and TypeScript and Python bindings.
- Accept supported snake_case aliases and emit camelCase fields. Discard incompatible extension declarations without invalidating the installed-plugin inventory.

## Testing

Add an integration test covering extension metadata preservation, field normalization, and unknown entrypoint and quick-action types across live and cached `plugin/installed` reads. Update pagination assertions to require `includeExtensions=true`.

GitOrigin-RevId: b73b0d13c151a30dc1fb9cda70b5cd6d7e3e2441

Subscribe authors to message-board channels created by posting (#47259)

## Why

Posting to a new channel subscribed its author to replies on that post, but not to new discussion roots in the channel. The creator could therefore miss notifications for subsequent discussions.

## What changed

Subscribe the author to the channel in the same transaction that creates the channel and its first post. Document this behavior in the API and the `new_channel_name` tool parameter.

## Testing

Update coverage to verify that channel creators receive notifications without explicit targeting and that posting to an existing channel preserves an explicit unsubscribe. Adjust thread-deletion test expectations for the additional persisted subscription.

GitOrigin-RevId: 5553ebc9f9b51456ab48886e9871733e93370a2b

Test spawn settings reporting after child removal (#47258)

## What changed

Add a V1 spawn regression test that removes the child from the thread manager during startup, before spawn reports its settings. Verify that the completed spawn event retains the role-configured model and reasoning effort, nickname, and role even when the child can no longer be looked up.

Also verify that the child receives its initial input with the effective settings and the parent receives a successful spawn result.

GitOrigin-RevId: 5e94e3ddb0feda0eaaa86e7539ef8c6720176f88

Preserve explicit message-board unsubscribes when posting (#47257)

## Why

Posting to a discussion automatically subscribed its author, undoing an explicit unsubscribe and restoring unwanted reply notifications.

## What changed

Persist explicit opt-outs so posting follows a discussion by default but leaves unsubscribed agents opted out until explicitly subscribed again. Keep active subscriptions in the existing table for compatibility with older readers, and remove opt-outs when deleting a board. Update the API and tool descriptions to explain the behavior.

## Testing

Extend the local board test to cover reopening an older database, preserving opt-outs across reopen and subsequent posts, legacy subscription queries, explicit notifications without resubscribing, explicit resubscription, and board cleanup.

GitOrigin-RevId: 8b8f7f50cea5041541b8d93067c52db18cdde85c

Return agent snapshots from `close_agent` (#47252)

## What changed

Return an `AgentInfo` snapshot captured before shutdown, including metadata for known unloaded agents. Use the snapshot's status and metadata in the tool's completion event and its status in `previous_status`, replacing the separate status subscription.

Preserve the pre-close status for error reporting when shutdown removes the target before a descendant fails to close. Propagate unexpected thread lookup errors before attempting shutdown.

GitOrigin-RevId: bdbd877aaf0389e830d6a7e84a5e14bb7d47277a

Drop descendant channel posts from retained remote compaction v2 history (#47249)

## Why

Remote compaction v2 excluded descendant progress messages from retained history but kept `CHANNEL_POST` messages from those same agents.

## What changed

Treat descendant `CHANNEL_POST` messages like `MESSAGE` progress updates when selecting history to retain after remote compaction v2.

## Testing

Extend the remote compaction test to verify that a child channel post is included in the compaction input and omitted from the follow-up request.

GitOrigin-RevId: 204bf44b8cddf1e6dc1e48234f51d4ac2aaf2e9f

Add explicit app and account targets to MCP resource reads (#47248)

## What changed

Allow `mcpServer/resource/read` to specify `target: {connectorId, linkId}` for direct hosted app reads without tool discovery, when supported by the backend. Require an explicit `linkId`: a string selects an account, while `null` requests no-auth access subject to backend policy.

Restrict direct targets to `codex_apps` and reject empty connector IDs, empty link IDs, and synthetic link IDs. Preserve originating app/account scope when `originCallId` and `threadId` are supplied, and retain discovery when `target` is omitted.

Update protocol schemas and TypeScript and Python models, preserving required-but-nullable `linkId` semantics in Python code generation.

## Testing

Extend resource-read tests to check target metadata with and without a thread, including explicit no-auth targets and omitted targets. Add Python model tests for string and null `linkId` values and rejection of a missing `linkId`.

GitOrigin-RevId: 8cf5595fbdd937193aeb529901fc95299f6e18ad

Centralize agent resume handling in `LocalAgentControl` (#47244)

## What changed

Add `LocalAgentControl::resume_agent` to reuse an existing thread or restore it from its rollout when lookup returns `ThreadNotFound`. Return the agent's current status, metadata, and configuration snapshot.

Route the `resume_agent` tool through this method, replacing its status-based resume check and separate restoration helper.

GitOrigin-RevId: 2ae0572a030f169eca1760ba0aff1fb9e2ab6651

Prevent V2 agent eviction from racing with queued messages (#47240)

## Why

Accepted inter-agent messages can still be waiting in the submission queue when a worker appears idle. Evicting that worker can lose the queued work, while cancelling an eviction caller can leave shutdown unfinished and allow delivery to a closing runtime.

## What changed

- Pin V2 recipients until queued submissions are handled or dropped, and verify that delivery targets the registered runtime.
- Move `Submission` into core so it can carry the residency guard through queue handoffs.
- Give eviction exclusive access to each runtime and keep it counted against capacity until removal. Run teardown in a separate task so it completes even if its caller is cancelled, and remove registry and residency entries together.

## Testing

Add a regression test covering queued follow-up delivery, eviction refusal while mail is pending, cancelled eviction completing teardown, rejection of late delivery, and capacity reuse after removal.

GitOrigin-RevId: d6de3d68cb6b911942e9ddfc05c65b3741b796b2

Suppress agent message board notifications to the post author (#47236)

## Why

Channel and thread subscriptions, or explicit `agents_to_notify`, could cause agents to receive notifications for their own posts.

## What changed

Exclude the author from notification recipients, even when explicitly targeted. Preserve the author's subscriptions so replies from other agents still reach them, and document this requirement in the board API.

## Testing

Update board tests to cover explicit self-targeting, subscribed authors, and delivery of other agents' replies. Update the model-context scenario and snapshot to verify posts remain searchable without a `CHANNEL_POST` self-notification.

GitOrigin-RevId: 0b2558e7df79122a6da06ad592f9735ba260cce1

Route multi-agent spawning through `SpawnRequest` (#47235)

## What changed

- Route both multi-agent spawn handlers through `LocalAgentControl::spawn`, accepting user input or an agent message.
- Centralize spawn message attribution and canonical path validation, and require message input to use `TriggerTurn`.
- Return the child's configuration snapshot alongside `LiveAgent`, so handlers obtain effective settings directly from spawning without a separate lookup.
- Update child test fixtures to use the shared spawn entry point.

GitOrigin-RevId: 9f9278df08041a62215f9ec3d38688c78fc5e0e2

Preserve MCP request trace context across transport workers (#47212)

## Why

MCP requests pass through background transport queues, so HTTP requests need the caller's trace context carried explicitly to preserve trace ancestry.

## What changed

- Capture W3C trace context in request metadata for tool and resource operations, custom requests, and event streams.
- Restore that context in an `mcp.http.request` span around HTTP POSTs, linking outgoing HTTP traces to the originating request.
- Preserve application metadata while replacing trace fields with the current caller's context and removing stale `tracestate`. Read the SDK's merged metadata so extension fields retain precedence over parameter metadata.

## Testing

Add a unit test for metadata merge precedence and an integration test covering concurrent paginated requests, tool calls, custom requests, and tool-call continuations across legacy and `2026-07-28` protocol modes. Verify HTTP trace ancestry, metadata preservation, and removal of stale `tracestate`.

GitOrigin-RevId: 0b22cd75f31f9fcb855b27fa8d34ecdffd6e3549

Add explicit gateway OAuth sign-in to app-server (#47207)

## Why

Clients with a gateway sign-in UI need to control when browser authorization starts and inspect credential readiness before making authenticated requests.

## What changed

- Add `initialize.capabilities.explicitGatewayOauth` to require explicit login while allowing existing credentials to refresh. Preserve automatic authorization for clients that omit the capability, and prevent later connections from undoing explicit opt-in.
- Add `account/gatewayOAuth/read`, `account/gatewayOAuth/login`, and `account/gatewayOAuth/cancel`, plus `account/gatewayOAuth/changed` notifications. Send the authorization URL only to the initiating connection and cancel its login on disconnect.
- Check gateway authentication before returning cached results from `model/list`, with restart guidance when provider settings have changed.
- Update protocol schemas, TypeScript and Python bindings, and document capability probing and the sign-in lifecycle.

## Testing

Add tests for passive readiness reads, credential reuse after login, token exchange failures, cancellation and immediate retry, connection ownership, legacy versus explicit login, and model-list authentication checks.

GitOrigin-RevId: a26e116a62c9f3db84dc238a40b7f4e816eb1594

Resolve proxy routes for standalone web search redirects (#47204)

## Why

Standalone web search selected a proxy route only for the initial endpoint. Redirect destinations can require a different system proxy route.

## What changed

- Add `RouteAwareClientPool` support to `ReqwestTransport` for both buffered and streaming requests, and use it for standalone web search.
- Preserve default Codex headers and Cloudflare cookie handling across routes, while retaining the default client behavior when route-aware handling is disabled or Codex is sandboxed.
- Share request construction so URL authentication and header precedence follow `reqwest` semantics, applying them once before redirects and TLS retries.
- Map route-aware failures to transport errors and remove request URLs from those errors.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for redirects through distinct proxies, preservation of POST bodies and default headers, URL authentication and header precedence, and transport error classification without URL leakage.

GitOrigin-RevId: 19a10a62118846db09dd95265dc277e54aac09ef

Separate thread preparation from execution persistence (#47199)

## Why

Injecting context before the first turn currently forces a full flush. Stores need a preparation checkpoint that can leave disposable context in memory, while local storage must keep prepared context durable before the first user input.

## What changed

- Add `PersistContext::ThreadPreparation` and `CodexThread::checkpoint_preparation()`, and use the checkpoint in `inject_response_items()`.
- Allow stores to defer rollout-derived metadata writes through `record_thread_metadata()`, including during preparation and execution checkpoints. Keep standard metadata updates synchronous.
- Flush local storage at preparation checkpoints so injected context survives restart.

## Testing

Add tests showing that preparation and first sampling can proceed without waiting for durable metadata. Cover prepared context in first and follow-up requests, plus durability before first input and restoration after restart, in both legacy and paginated history modes.

GitOrigin-RevId: 74f6bb1a5f8d47192364b8bba6afd703a3b7d688

Render aligned equations and optimization notation in TUI math (#47191)

## Why

Aligned equations and common optimization notation previously fell back to TeX source. Scripts without Unicode equivalents also prevented otherwise supported expressions from rendering.

## What changed

- Add display layouts for `aligned` and `\boxed`, preserving fraction geometry and alignment with surrounding math.
- Stack sum limits and `\underset`/`\overset` annotations in display math, with compact forms for inline math and nested arguments.
- Support `\substack`, uppercase `\mathcal`, and single-grapheme `\widehat`.
- Preserve scripts without Unicode equivalents using explicit grouping, such as `x_{gpt}` and `x^{q+1}`.
- Keep layouts bounded and retain source fallback for unsupported input or expressions that do not fit.

## Testing

Add snapshots and regression tests for optimization models, display limits, grouped scripts, fraction alignment, narrow-width fallback, malformed input, and layout bounds. Add streaming coverage comparing character-by-character output with complete rendering at wide and narrow widths in rich and raw modes.

GitOrigin-RevId: 83937880a309375f472228368ebe885d4f50bf9c

Allow forking conversations locked by another app in the TUI (#47185)

## Why

Conversations open in another app disable the composer. Let users continue in an editable fork while the original conversation remains owned by that app.

## What changed

- Add an `f`/`F` shortcut and footer hint to the locked conversation view, preserving local drafts and queued prompts in the fork.
- Show “Forking conversation…” while a fork is pending, block additional key input, and discard buffered input after forking from the locked view.
- Replace the previous session summary after a fork with “Fork created. You can continue here.”
- Keep the locked view and draft intact if the fork request fails.

## Testing

Add tests for shortcut ownership and modifiers, repeated input, editable forks that preserve drafts and queued prompts without taking the source lease, and failure recovery. Add snapshots for fork progress, completion, and the updated footer.

GitOrigin-RevId: 2ecdb0b7fc7e82d8295097faa567995d7a2f7d92

Enable automatic daemon startup by default (#47179)

## What changed

Promote `daemon_auto_start` to stable and enable it by default for eligible interactive launches. Remove its entry from `/experimental`.

## Testing

Update daemon startup, `--no-daemon`, and startup failure tests to exercise the default without explicitly enabling the feature. Disable daemon startup in unrelated TUI and path-safety test fixtures.

GitOrigin-RevId: 107d71108b96d09431148d7d61f10c6381929e05

Enable the fullscreen transcript by default (#47178)

## What changed

Default `tui.fullscreen_transcript` to `true`, including when the `[tui]`
section is absent, and apply the same default to the first frame. Update the
configuration schema to match. Alternate-screen restrictions still take
precedence, and `tui.fullscreen_transcript=false` restores terminal scrollback.

## Testing

Update configuration and startup tests for the new default, including an empty
`[tui]` section and `--no-alt-screen`. Adjust PTY tests to cover default fullscreen
entry and explicit opt-out to terminal scrollback.

GitOrigin-RevId: e460dcd058d52c50da2abc5113bbb678e845d5fc

Preserve empty cell metadata under pending tool-call pressure (#47174)

## Why

Reaching the pending tool-call limit could evict finished empty cells even though removing them frees no pending-call capacity. This loses the metadata needed to certify an empty tool-call inventory on a later `wait`.

## What changed

Only evict cells with pending calls when reclaiming pending-call capacity. Keep empty cells eligible for eviction when a cell slot is needed.

## Testing

Extend recorder coverage to check empty inventories under pending-call pressure in fresh and resumed sessions. Add a code-mode integration test verifying that `wait` serializes an empty inventory with `tool_calls_complete: true` while another cell has filled the pending-call budget.

GitOrigin-RevId: 559d0b4fdc9864c42a90b7d087eb2a3327272d5c

Add explicit gateway login control and authentication status (#47170)

## What changed

- Add `GatewayLoginControl` so hosts can require caller-initiated browser authorization while retaining automatic login by default.
- Expose passive readiness checks, scoped status subscriptions, and cancellable browser login that reports success after credentials are persisted.
- Return non-retryable request errors for `LoginRequired` and `LoginInProgress`, while preserving retries for transient authentication failures.
- Keep rejected credentials unready until replaced, and prevent slow readiness reads from blocking cached requests or overwriting newer credentials.

## Testing

Add coverage for login cancellation, status notifications, external credential recovery, concurrent credential I/O, legacy automatic login, and request retry behavior.

GitOrigin-RevId: e236d203998ceb6eeaca9704cc05d20ad45f2931

Apply workspace routing to Guardian v2 classifier requests (#47162)

## Why

Classifier requests need to preserve their owning thread's workspace routing and account binding, including when reusing pooled connections or retrying after authentication changes.

## What changed

- Share the thread's `WorkspaceRoutingContext` with Guardian v2 and resolve routing before leasing HTTP or pooled WebSocket connections.
- Reuse WebSockets only when their connection key and authentication state still match. Cache HTTP transports by URL and redirect policy, rejecting redirects when routing requires it.
- Stop classification requests and retries when the account owner changes while allowing token refreshes for the same user and workspace.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for routing failures with prewarmed sockets, shared thread routing state, account switches during HTTP and WebSocket requests, same-account token refreshes, and HTTP redirect-policy cache changes.

GitOrigin-RevId: 7b3efcadb4797b6a2de2e28e7506b297b0728d69

Expose HTTP origins in MCP server status (#47159)

## What changed

Add nullable `httpOrigin` to `McpServerStatus`, derived from the effective configured endpoint for both configured and plugin-provided servers. Return only the HTTP(S) origin, excluding credentials, path, query, and fragment; return `null` for stdio transports, invalid URLs, and non-HTTP(S) schemes. Update the generated protocol schemas and TypeScript and Python types.

## Testing

Extend status integration tests to cover configured and plugin-provided HTTP servers, verify that endpoint paths and query parameters are omitted, and assert `null` for a stdio server. Update protocol tests to check null serialization and compatibility with older inventory responses.

GitOrigin-RevId: 033ebdeefe829e3a48b2d4ab7d8866dac4cda5c5

Harden gateway OAuth credential persistence and error redaction (#47158)

## Why

Credential I/O can block async workers, and canceled browser logins must not release the credential store lock while a write is still running. Provider errors can also echo secrets from authorization URL query parameters.

## What changed

- Move credential reads and writes to `spawn_blocking`, retaining the cross-process lock until encryption and the atomic write finish, even if the caller is canceled.
- Clear pending rotated credentials during browser login only when stored credentials have changed, preserving recovery after a failed login without overwriting an external login.
- Omit provider response details and request IDs when the authorization URL contains query parameters, matching the existing protection for token and resource URLs.

## Testing

Extend regression coverage for authorization URL query-secret redaction and failed browser login after a failed credential save, including retry, expiration, and external-login recovery.

GitOrigin-RevId: 4a63702a260fd7f3e2ad2314b0124c0d647d4f12

Ignore stale thread-close notifications after resuming a thread (#47155)

## Why

A queued close notification from an old runtime can arrive after the same thread has been resumed. Because thread IDs survive reloads, handling that notification can incorrectly exit the TUI or switch away from the displayed thread.

## What changed

Confirm the displayed thread's status with `thread/read` before handling its close notification. Ignore the notification if the thread is still loaded. Bound verification to five seconds and retry an internal server error once.

If verification fails, reconnect remote sessions. Preserve close handling for embedded sessions, unreadable unpersisted threads, and servers that do not support the request.

## Testing

Add regression tests for stale and genuine close notifications, plus disconnects, timeouts, transient and persistent server errors, embedded-session fallback, and unsupported requests.

GitOrigin-RevId: 783433b11ed268aed521f3b2cc4d0aa3a36a3836

Update code mode catalog snapshot hashes (#47149)

Refresh the collaboration namespace hash and aggregate tools hash in the
`code_mode_catalog_messages` snapshot.

GitOrigin-RevId: bcfb793ba379760219cb4214d39f9c8bcd01e40c

Extract exec-server CLI startup into a dedicated module (#47143)

## What changed

Move `codex exec-server` argument definitions, transport validation, configuration loading, authentication, and shutdown orchestration from `codex-rs/cli/src/main.rs` into `codex-rs/cli/src/exec_server_command.rs`.

Expose startup through `ExecServerCommand::run`, merge the root `--strict-config` flag into the command before dispatch, and update existing argument tests to use the new entry point.

GitOrigin-RevId: 4bcc59db2bd6e1d153a366142bd0b93ad03c6951

Honor system proxy settings for standalone web search (#47142)

## Why

Standalone web search used a default HTTP client, bypassing the configured system proxy route when `respect_system_proxy` was enabled.

## What changed

Pass the configured `HttpClientFactory` to the web search tool and create its client asynchronously for the provider's search URL using the API route policy. Export and reuse `SEARCH_ENDPOINT` so route selection and search requests use the same endpoint.

## Testing

Add an isolated regression test with environment proxies removed and a mock system proxy. Verify that standalone web search reaches the proxy and returns its result in the follow-up model request.

GitOrigin-RevId: 3b64803a777b9d1eb0ccf694e06658b0fd562129

Prevent horizontal transcript selection from triggering autoscroll (#47137)

## Why

Dragging horizontally along the top or bottom transcript row could trigger autoscroll, moving the text under the pointer while selecting it.

## What changed

Require vertical pointer movement from the initial press row before selection autoscroll can begin. Remember that movement so a vertical drag can return to its starting edge and still autoscroll, and preserve the original pointer row across wheel scrolling.

## Testing

Extend regression tests and snapshots for horizontal selection at both edges, stable selected text across repeated ticks, wheel scrolling before the first drag, and autoscroll after a vertical drag returns to its starting edge.

GitOrigin-RevId: e13f3a80adbead1eecbeb281301667c8e12e1541

Support caller-provided MITM CAs in the network proxy (#47132)

## What changed

- Add optional `network.mitm_ca` configuration with `certificate_file` and
  `private_key_file` for trusted proxy configuration. Require MITM to be enabled
  and retain the generated CA when no external CA is configured.
- Validate absolute paths, regular files, file sizes, certificate/key matching,
  and Unix private-key permissions. Reject symlinks on Unix, private keys embedded
  in certificate files, and external private keys on non-Unix platforms.
- Store derived external-CA trust bundles in the proxy artifact directory,
  include only certificates, and skip inherited generated bundles to avoid
  retaining stale roots.
- Preserve MITM for external CAs when disabling credential brokerage. Reject
  external CA configuration for remote execution, even when the proxy is disabled,
  and reject unknown fields in `NetworkProxyConfig`.
- Default the upstream request version adapter to HTTP/1.1 and remove the request
  URI from upstream request failure context.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for external CA configuration, mismatched keys, embedded
private keys, non-Unix rejection, trust-bundle placement and contents, stale-root
exclusion, credential-broker toggling, and remote configuration rejection.

GitOrigin-RevId: cb209295c19fbe53a9fa0194f11ff06acccabef6

Remove the `ultrafast` service tier from `gpt-5.6-sol` (#47130)

## What changed

Remove `ultrafast` from the bundled `gpt-5.6-sol` model's `service_tiers`, leaving `priority` (Fast) as its only advertised service tier. Update scenario snapshots for the affected multi-agent tool definitions.

GitOrigin-RevId: 9a235d8f7ea8a72e71152708d2d602194256d420

Preserve foreign working directories in extension tool environments (#47129)

## Why

Extension calls omitted environments whose working directories could not be converted to host-native paths, preventing extensions from receiving those environments.

## What changed

Store `ToolEnvironment.cwd` as `PathUri` and pass all turn environments to extension tools without requiring host-native path conversion. Keep image generation's existing path requirements by selecting the first environment with a convertible working directory when reading referenced images or saving generated images.

GitOrigin-RevId: b4320c6e07d27ef59885cd0013e5d1c535f69659

Add extra policy configuration for Guardian reviews (#47125)

## What changed

- Add `auto_review.extra_policy` and the managed `guardian_extra_policy` requirement to supply policy text alongside the resolved tenant policy. Nonblank managed values take precedence; blank values are ignored.
- Render the additional text through `{{ extra_policy }}` in Guardian reviewer templates and append it to the tenant policy for Guardian v2 classification before truncation.
- Preserve placeholder-like text inside supplied policies literally.

## Testing

Add coverage for configuration precedence, blank values, template substitution, and classifier prompts, plus a scenario verifying that managed tenant and extra policies reach the Guardian reviewer together.

GitOrigin-RevId: 180d8d716c63fe96a92ec5bfbd22db4ddccd4f1f

Increase OpenAI file blob upload timeout from 60 seconds to 5 minutes (#47122)

GitOrigin-RevId: 11069394b3cfe24af4d5efb709ee4f65b88c90de

Pass thread IDs to attachment uploads (#47121)

## Why

Attachment stores need the receiving thread ID to support thread-based placement.

## What changed

Add `thread_id` to `UploadRequest` and pass the session's thread ID through image preparation for messages and tool outputs. Include the ID in debug output while continuing to redact attachment bytes.

## Testing

Extend the image rollout test to assert that a new image uploaded after resume carries the resumed session's thread ID. Update the debug-output test for the new field.

GitOrigin-RevId: f81e3bd761dca704064287177b8ecd7175662f07

Support model-catalog overrides for Code Mode tool messages (#47118)

## What changed

- Add `tools.code_mode` catalog messages for `exec`, `wait`, deferred-tool guidance, and shared MCP TypeScript definitions.
- Render `{{ default_exec_yield_time_ms }}` and `{{ image_helper }}` in `exec` descriptions while preserving runtime tool declarations and the freeform grammar.
- Resolve `wait` descriptions and parameter schemas independently, falling back to bundled parameters for invalid or unsupported schemas.
- Use the active model's Code Mode messages, including after mid-turn model changes. Missing overrides retain bundled defaults; empty text overrides suppress the corresponding text.

## Testing

Add coverage for literal template substitution, runtime section preservation, independent `wait` overrides and fallback behavior, mid-turn model changes, and a yielded cell completing through `wait` with catalog messages.

GitOrigin-RevId: e542a0cd47a7138a414871192cee47790ed1214e

Honor the configured product SKU in remote plugin requests (#47116)

## Why

Remote plugin requests always sent `OAI-Product-Sku: codex`, ignoring the existing `apps_mcp_product_sku` setting.

## What changed

Pass `apps_mcp_product_sku` through plugin configuration and use it for authenticated remote plugin requests, including discovery, search, installation, and sharing. Keep `codex` as the default and include the SKU when comparing remote service configurations.

## Testing

Extend app-server plugin listing and core agent-turn tests to check default and configured SKU headers. Update the CLI worktree test to wait for the user prompt's model request, skipping background title generation requests.

GitOrigin-RevId: 508c9ef9aa3e41b87c92383c3088eb1eb9227fd8

Preserve and expose thread item lifecycle timestamps (#47114)

## What changed

- Persist producer-recorded item start and completion times in thread history, preserving existing non-null values on updates.
